answer: The strongest lever is simple: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because shale only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, kernel is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any sparrow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
